extent: Every Calamine-exposed cell and every sheet compared; all lexical changes inspected. Selected XML metadata cross-checks, not a visual workbook roundtrip.
limitations: Calamine is also the converter dependency; this comparison cannot independently detect every binding-level omission.
Formatting, merged-span relationships, chart/VBA objects and formula expressions are outside the value-only output contract.
path_convention: Artifact references are bundle-relative; source paths beginning tests/ or benchmarks/ are repository-relative. Source page and Markdown line references preserve original review evidence.
summary: All six source values survive, including the multi-day duration; raw XML dates have no hidden time component.
